Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Politics Stephen Obeng Saka declares intention to seek NPP Parliamentary candidacy for Asante Akyem North Source : Isaac Amoako 11 November 2026 2:35pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Stephen Obeng Saka has declared his intention to contest the New Patriotic Party’s parliamentary primaries for Asante Akyem North, pledging to prioritise party unity, business development and agricultural opportunities.
Having contested the party’s parliamentary primaries in 2024, Mr Obeng Saka says his intention to seek the nomination again reflects his continuing commitment to public service and the development of the constituency.
“My purpose is to serve, help create opportunities and work with our members to win back the parliamentary seat for the NPP. I will also support our presidential candidate to increase the party’s votes in the 2028 general election,” he stated.
Outlining his priorities, Mr Obeng Saka highlighted “Operation Own Your Own Business,” an initiative aimed at supporting entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods. He said he is already facilitating access to bank loans for small business owners, subject to the banks’ lending requirements.
He also pointed to his ongoing efforts to encourage young people to enter ginger farming through training facilitated by the Department of Agriculture. He intends to build on this work by pursuing partnerships that improve access to agricultural support and markets.
Mr Obeng Saka identified better roads and access to essential services as further priorities, explaining that he would work with the Municipal Assembly and relevant government agencies to advocate for investment and monitor progress.
On party organisation, he emphasised reconciliation, respect for grassroots members and cooperation among executives, former aspirants, elders and supporters. He also pledged to mobilise financial and logistical resources to support campaign activities, with transparent and accountable management.
“We must work together with a shared purpose. I will listen, respect the contributions of others and pursue a peaceful campaign focused on practical solutions,” he said.
Mr Obeng Saka’s declaration expresses his intention to seek the NPP’s parliamentary nomination, subject to the party’s official procedures and requirements.
